# AINative Builder
> AI that builds AND runs your company. Describe an idea; Cody (your AI co-founder) composes a real, running product or an operating AI-native company from real AINative primitives, then runs it 24/7.

## What it is
AINative Builder turns a one-line idea into an operating, AI-run company. You describe what you want; Cody builds the artifacts (product brief, PRD, data model, agent definitions, business model, positioning, landing page, 30-day plan), builds a real working app you can share, provisions the infrastructure on real AINative primitives, and then keeps running the company on a nightly autonomous loop. Unlike a code generator, Builder composes real, production-ready software and business systems from existing AINative products — not throwaway demos.

## How it beats the alternatives
- Not just "AI that runs your company while you sleep" (Polsia) — Builder BUILDS the company AND runs it, on real primitives you own.
- Not a UI/code generator (v0, Lovable, Bolt) — Builder produces a running product PLUS the operating company around it (CRM, invoicing, helpdesk, voice), each backed by a real AINative product.
- Real, production-ready output: apps are built and deployed to a durable, shareable URL; business systems are real ZeroPipeline / ZeroInvoice / ServiceOS / ZeroVoice, not mockups.
- Agent-native and fully transparent: watch every artifact get composed live; every artifact shows the exact AINative primitives powering it.

## Two tracks
- App Track: idea → Product Brief → PRD → Composition Plan → Data Model → Memory Policy → Agent Definition → Integrations → Build Backlog → Swarm → Infrastructure → Running Preview (a real app).
- Company Track: idea → Venture Thesis → Wedge → Business Model → Positioning → Landing Page → 30-Day Plan → Live operating dashboard.

## Real AINative primitives it composes from
ZeroDB (vectors + tables + managed embeddings), ZeroMemory (agent memory), GraphRAG, Agent Cloud (agent swarm), ZeroPipeline (CRM), ZeroInvoice (billing), ServiceOS (helpdesk), ZeroVoice (voice + SMS), AI Kit (UI + safety), MCP (tool access), OAuth 2.1. See https://docs.ainative.studio.

## The autonomous loop (runs while you sleep)
Every enrolled company gets a nightly run: Cody evaluates the company, picks the highest-leverage task, runs it on the AINative agent swarm, and delivers a morning summary. This is the same recursive self-improvement loop that builds AINative itself, surfaced live at https://ainative.studio/intelligence.

## Model
Primary generation is Claude (Sonnet 4.5 / Haiku 4.5 / Opus 4.5) via Amazon Bedrock, tiered by plan. Artifacts and the running app are generated from YOUR idea — every build is idea-specific, never a template.

## Start here
- Build: https://builder.ainative.studio/build
- Docs (all AINative primitives): https://docs.ainative.studio
- Live loop / social proof: https://ainative.studio/intelligence

## API (agent-callable)
- Generate an app from an idea: POST /api/chat-ws  { "message": "<idea>" }
- Generate a build artifact: POST /api/build/artifact  { "view": "thesis|prd|dataModel|...", "idea": "<idea>", "track": "app|company" }
- Ask Cody about a company: POST /api/build/ask  { "question": "<q>", "idea": "<idea>", "companyName": "<name>" }
- Live business systems: GET /api/build/systems?companyId=<id>
- Running preview of a generated app: GET /api/preview/{id}
- Enroll a company in the nightly loop: POST /api/build/enroll
- Health: GET /api/health
